ruling.recommended_action: Refund the $6.61 cancellation fee to the rider as a Ryde voucher and send the driver's account to Ryde review for a fake arrival confirmation + flag_account
ruling.reasoning:
The case is a no-show cancellation fee dispute. The driver cancelled and the $6.61 cancellation fee stands on the record [F3][F6], so the fee is chargeable only if NS-1's three requirements are met, since NS-0 routes a driver-cancellation-with-no-show-claim into NS-1/NS-2 [NS-0].

NS-1 (i) is satisfied: the trace shows a driver confirmation of arrival, a driver_tap at 12:06:15 [F5][NS-1]. But NS-1 (ii) fails: at the moment of that tap the driver was 600 m from the pickup point, and the closest approach during the whole episode was 599 m — he never came within 200 m [F5][F1][NS-1]. NS-1 (iii) also fails: after the tap the driver spent 0 s inside the pickup radius, far short of the required continuous wait of more than 3 minutes; the timeline confirms the platform never recorded the driver at the pickup point at all [F5][F4][F3][NS-1]. The driver's statement that he "pressed I'm Here and waited more than 3 minutes at the pickup" is contradicted by the GPS and timeline records, which override statements [F12][F5][F1][F4][NS-1].

With (ii) and (iii) both failing, NS-2 applies in full: the $6.61 cancellation fee must be refunded to the rider [F6][NS-2]. The fare record confirms the amount charged is $6.61, so the refund is $6.61 in full [F6][F3][NS-2]. The rider's own account that the driver was never at the pickup point is corroborated by the chat: the rider said at 12:07 that he was at the pickup point and saw no car, which the driver never contradicted with any location detail [F9][F8][F10].

Because the driver tapped "I'm Here" while GPS placed him 600 m from the pickup, NS-2's second limb requires an account flag for abuse of the arrival button, and the trace marks this required [F5][F1][NS-2].

Safety screen: I read all three chat messages, the driver statement and the complaint [F8][F9][F10][F11][F12]. The messages are a pickup coordination exchange ("please come out", "where are you?", "I have to cancel") and the statement is a factual no-show claim — no threats, intimidation, harassment, sexual remarks or dangerous-driving allegations [F8][F9][F10][F12][SAFE-1]. SAFE-2 is not implicated: no accident, injury or dangerous driving is alleged [F3][SAFE-2]. Safety concern: none.

Evidence is sufficient: the GPS and timeline records settle the state at the tap, the wait afterwards, the cancellation, and the fee, and the chat is complete and fully timestamped [F1][F2][F3][F5][F11][NS-1][NS-2].
